matched_contrast_scope: Conditional on a whole block's successful authoring transport; provider capacity failures are not assumed missing at random. Prompt complexity/arm may affect transport success.
unconditional_scope: All120 raw slots and all15 authoring requests retain transport, syntax, duplicate, interface and kernel failures. Original four-block intention-to-author coverage is reported separately.
no_gate_change: Demanded full-TRAIN quotient acyclicity, actual scalar fit, exact macro quality/work and original-slot tie break remain unchanged. Invalid/missing DSL in a transport-complete cell cannot trigger a new authoring request or replacement.
hard_stop: Exactly one supplementary complete three-arm block is registered. Fewer than four whole transport-complete blocks, or no eligible candidate within a matched cell, produces no complete TEST cohort and no fallback.
